Bonferroni on any three moved points bounds all other cycle types strictly below it by Delta_n>0 for every n>=5. Boundary n=5,6,7 and recurrence n>=8 are checked. Distinct independent code paths enumerate all types through n=8 and restrictions through n=8.

originality.rationale: The inspected January 2026 primary article explicitly states the transposition-maximizing conjecture, proves only the fixed radii 5,6,7, and tabulates radii 8 through 14. Its general character formula computes maxima but does not classify an infinite diagonal of unique maximizing center types. The older 2024/2025 paper supplies prescribed-center-distance formulas and large-n-for-fixed-r results, neither shown to imply the n=r+1 diagonal. Searches of mathematical research records and accessible own claims found no equivalent global diagonal theorem. Full older text access failure leaves a genuine priority risk.
residual_risks: The 2024/2025 full predecessor paper was unavailable, so there could be a stronger implicit consequence of its fixed-center-distance calculations or sufficiently-large-n theorem.
Novelty assessment uses accessible sources and searches, not exhaustive coverage of unindexed mathematical literature.
No independent review of the proof or scientific priority has been performed.

value.rationale: This is an explicit unbounded diagonal family of a natural published open extremality conjecture for permutation Hamming reconstruction, with a strict maximizer classification and exact all-length ambiguity count. It determines the precise channel threshold in a regime with growing radius; it is not just a routine evaluation of a fixed-radius table.
